lines.text: Asaph's song gives thanks to God because His Name is near.
God says He will judge fairly, and He tells the proud not to boast.
Exaltation comes neither from east nor north nor the desert, but God judges, bringing down one and exalting another.
The LORD holds a cup of foaming wine, and all the wicked of the earth drink it.
The singer will praise the God of Abraham, and the horns of the wicked will be cut off.
